note: faw-universal's own epitaph already flagged "Xander and Sean Mason both billed as champion" across FAW's later 2003 corpus; this row resolves the Mason side of that flag. The Xander billing is not yet resolved -- watch FAW Extreme Beating Three (30 March 2003) and FAW Panic (6 April 2003), where Xander is independently active, for the actual transition.
